paragraphs: The F-Pace 400 Sport was launched in 2022 as a special edition, distinguished by its use of the Ingenium AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid assistance. This is the same engine family as the standard F-Pace P400, but the 400 Sport carries the badge as a separate, high-spec variant. It's part of Jaguar's newer-generation six-cylinder Ingenium range, paired with a 48V mild-hybrid system for improved responsiveness and efficiency.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every F-Pace 400 Sport on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol MHEV fitted to the F-Pace 400 Sport from 2022 onwards (X761). The same Ingenium 6-cylinder pattern shared with the F-Pace D300 diesel and P400 petrol variants — we service it to the same standard as our other F-Pace rebuilds, replacing timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard.

compatibility.intro: The F-Pace 400 Sport's AJ300P is a specifically-tuned version of the 3.0-litre Ingenium six-cylinder. While it shares its core architecture with other Ingenium six-cylinder engines in the F-Pace range, its ECU calibration, power output (400PS) and mild-hybrid setup are unique to the 400 Sport badge.
